ojas (Eng-Platform): Quick sync — we need to define the exact runtime/infra metrics to drive the new dashboard tiles AND the RBAC/sharing model. Thinking: separate internal telemetry (debug traces, KV-cache internals) vs customer-facing KPIs (p50/p95 latency, cost/token).

marta (Product): +1. Product needs a tenant-scoped view for customers (latency, tokens, errors) and an internal expanded view that adds throttles, routing-fallback counts, and rollout flags. Customers should never see internal node ids or raw traces.

daniel (Eng-Infra): From infra side: we can export per-request labels: tenant_id, route_policy, model_variant, host_pool. Need to decide which labels are redacted for customer exports. Also storage/retention: audit logs must be retained 365 days for compliance.

sara (Eng-ML): For ML/quality: add model-level signal: kv_cache_hit_rate, prompt_truncation_rate, effective_context_len. Those help detect regressions after rollouts. Can we tag metrics with `rollout_id` and `canary_pct`?

mojas (sic) (Eng-Platform): @sara you mean `rollout_id` on traces/metrics — yes. We should also surface routing policy hit ratio (how often requests fell back to cheaper variant). Important for cost/accounting.

marta (Product): Also need a clear sharing policy: customers get a "Tenant Dashboard" link that only includes their tenant_id. Internal teams get a "Workspace" that can join multiple tenants (support, sales) but access must be audited. How do we handle cross-team support access?

daniel (Eng-Infra): Proposed model: roles = [viewer, support, admin]. Granting support requires an approval flow and an audit entry: `support_grant_{user}_{tenant}_{ts}`. We can implement in console: checkbox "allow support access" per tenant with expiry.

sara (Eng-ML): For any metric surfaced to customers, strip host/instance metadata and aggregate to at least 1m bucket to prevent inferring infra details.

odds-bot: (typo) — ignore

audits-bot: policy-event: support_grant_alice@example.com:tenant-42:approved by marta (Product) at 1794205590

ojas (Eng-Platform): Pinned action items: 1) define metric whitelist for customer dashboards (marta + sara) 2) export label list and redaction rules (daniel) 3) RBAC UI copy + approval flow spec (marta + eng-security) 4) telemetry retention + query access controls (eng-infra). I'll spin up a small spec.

marta (Product): I'll draft the customer whitelist. Initial candidate keys: [p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, errors_per_min, model_variant]. Anything else?

daniel (Eng-Infra): Add `quota_usage_pct` and `route_fallback_count` to that list. For infra we will emit `node_id` and `gpu_uuid` but those go to internal only.

osjas (Eng-Platform): Example redaction rule (pseudo-DSL):
```
allow view.customer -> metrics.* where metric_scope == "tenant" and NOT label in ["node_id","gpu_uuid","raw_trace"]
allow role.support -> metrics.* where grant.approved == true
```

marta (Product): Good. Also UX note: when customer tries to "share dashboard" we should default to a "snapshot" export (CSV/pdf) rather than granting live access unless they pick "grant live access" and accept TOS + data boundaries.

sara (Eng-ML): One more: expose a "model health" badge (OK/WARNING/DEGRADED) derived from kv_cache_hit_rate and prompt_truncation_rate so support can triage quickly without deep telemetry. That can be customer-facing.

daniel (Eng-Infra): Implementation constraints: we will need to add tenant-scoped read tokens for the metrics-api; these tokens should be single-purpose for dashboards and cannot query audit logs.

audits-bot: retention-policy: metrics-api-queries -> 90 days for customer-scoped, 365 days for internal/admin queries

ojas (Eng-Platform): Ok team — I'll draft a one-pager with the whitelist, redaction table, RBAC roles, and a proposed API sample for queries. Tagging: @marta @daniel @sara. Will post by EOD. :eyes:
